source: Words that are the same in both languages, such as "Plugins" in German, are still reported. That is why the check reports at {0}, which {1} does not turn into an error. {2} removes such keys, from every check.
text: 在两种语言中写法相同的词，例如德语中的 "Plugins"，仍然会被报告。因此该检查的报告级别为 {0}，{1} 不会将其视为错误。{2} 会从所有检查中移除这类键。
